lines.text: Agur son of Jakeh declares his words to Ithiel and says he has not learned wisdom.
Agur asks God to give him neither poverty nor riches, lest he become poor and boast.
The leech has two daughters, Give and Give, and the ravens of the valley pluck out the mocking eye.
The ants store up food in the summer, and the lizard is found in the temple courts.
Agur says to put your hand over your mouth, for the stirring of anger brings forth strife.
